inlineVariantsPolicy: Count separately listed official cards only. S9 inline color swatches (11 in one retained card) are recorded as display options, not 11 cards or new canonical identities. Historical snapshot does not establish whether individual inline swatches changed.
findingCountPolicy: Distinct productId:path in explicitly audited objective field groups; excludes prices and uncollected AF/EVF/battery/shutter/release/etc. Absent and null count as UNKNOWN; arrays count as one known leaf, verified parent object covers child leaves. Field paths and leaf counts are separate metrics. Dedicated structured identity evidence is not synonymous with reviewed production identity mapping. IBIS stop ratings for explicitly absent body stabilization (GH5S) are not applicable and excluded from UNKNOWN counts.
